//port: Port 4322, not 3000. `node build/index.js` defaults to 3000, which local daemons
commonly squat (OrbStack claims it on at least one machine here) — lhci's readiness
probe then sees *something* listening, proceeds, and audits a stranger's server.
It surfaces as a bare `Status code: 404` with no hint that the port is the cause.
playwright.config.ts avoids the same trap on 4321.
//url: The three PRD reference routes are /, /programs/ev-challenge and /contact-us.
/programs/ev-challenge was missing until now — the heaviest public page (Threlte
3D canvas + the largest image set) was the one route never measured.
The /zh mirrors are included because only they load Noto Sans SC; an English-only
URL list cannot see a CJK font regression.

//assert: Staged tightening (plan D-3), implemented as a per-route RATCHET rather than one global
threshold. The PRD target is LCP <= 2500ms at error level; a blanket 2500 today would
leave CI red from the first run and destroy the gate's signal value.
LHCI keys assertions by audit id in `level | [level, options]` form, so one audit cannot
carry both a warn and an error threshold in the same set — hence assertMatrix, whose
patterns below are mutually exclusive so exactly one entry applies per URL.
/programs/ev-challenge carries a looser ceiling because it ALREADY failed 4500ms before
any of this work: measured on the same localhost setup at commit 12e2629 (pre-palette) it
was LCP 6.94s / perf 70 / 2120 KiB, against 7.24s / 68 after. That is run-to-run noise on
a 7-second page, not a regression. The failure only became visible because that route was
added to the URL list here — it had never been measured at all. The ceiling is set just
above the observed value so the page cannot get WORSE while the debt is outstanding; it
is a ratchet, not an exemption. Tracked in docs/LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md.
As each route is measured under a tighter bound, move its pattern into a stricter entry.

//zh: Chinese pages carry a CJK webfont that English pages do not. 900 Han glyphs is
251 KB across two weights and that is irreducible — it is already subset to exactly
the characters this site can render, cut from five weights to two, served with
font-display: optional and deliberately NOT preloaded so it cannot outrank the LCP
element. The journey on /zh LCP: 11.58s for the naive fix, 5.65s after all of that.
